gates.claim: THE ANSWER TO ROUTE 56'S OPEN ITEM, and it is a negative. From y1*y2*y3 = 1, y3*(1 - y1*y2) = y3 - 1, so 1 - y1*conj(y1) = (y3-1)/y3 -- and y3 = 0.43016 in (0,1) makes that a NEGATIVE REAL, namely minus the plastic number. A negative real is off slitPlane, so log(1-xy) sits exactly on its branch cut and PentagonRegular fails at the pair Vol(5_2) needs. No region reaches it because the configuration is on the boundary of the domain

on the boundary is not outside. The straight segment from ANY real a in (0,1) to y_1, with conj(y_1) fixed, is regular at EVERY interior point -- 1500 samples each, five values of a, zero interior failures. Only t = 1 fails, and only in the single argument 1 - w*y. (A sampled sweep cannot prove the absence of an interior failure; it is reported as what it is)
gates.sampling_caveat: interior regularity is sampled, not certified

gates.claim: and the approach is from the CONTINUOUS side. Im(1 - w*conj(y1)) = a*(1-t)*Im(y1) > 0 all along, decreasing to 0 -- the upper half-plane, which is where the principal Complex.log (arg in (-pi, pi]) is continuous at a negative real. So what is owed is a BOUNDARY-CONTINUITY argument at one point, not a search for a region: a different and much smaller problem than Route 56 left open. It is NOT closed here

the exceptional structure at the pair, all equivalent to the cubic itself: (1-a)(1-b) = (1-ab)^2 for any two roots, so a5 = 1/a3; here additionally a5 = conj(a3), hence |a3| = 1 -- the two composite arguments sit on the UNIT CIRCLE. Verified symbolically by Groebner reduction against a+b+c=2, ab+ac+bc=3, abc=1 before being measured

the target is unmoved. G1 is a negative -- the pair is on the cut, so Route 56's region does not exist. G2 and G3 say the residue is boundary continuity at a single point, which is smaller but is not done. A = sum Li2(y_j) still has no proof

verdict.negative: 1 - y_1*conj(y_1) = (y_3-1)/y_3 is a NEGATIVE REAL (minus the plastic number), so the 5_2 conjugate pair lies ON the branch cut and PentagonRegular fails there. Route 56's region does not exist.
verdict.sharpening: but only the endpoint fails, only in one argument, and the approach is from the upper half-plane where the principal log is continuous. The residue is boundary continuity at one point.
verdict.not_done: no boundary-continuity argument is supplied here.
